sources.title: Cohere's Command A+ Model
sources.evidence: Exact API ID; provider Cohere; release May 20, 2026; 128,000-token context; text/image input and text output; reasoning and tool use. Reports sparse MoE, 218B total and 25B active, with Apache 2.0 distribution.

sources.title: Introducing Command A+: Making sovereign agentic capabilities available to all
sources.evidence: May 20, 2026 launch announcement identifies command-a-plus-05-2026 and publishes the 218B/25B sparse-MoE specifications, Apache 2.0 license and downloadable weights. Describes multilingual, multimodal, reasoning and agentic use.

sources.title: Command A+ BF16 model card
sources.evidence: Names the exact model and its BF16, FP8 and W4A4 releases. Reports 218B total and 25B active. Describes a decoder-only sparse MoE Transformer, 128 routed experts with eight selected per token, thinking tokens and trained conversational tool use.

sources.title: Announcing Cohere's Command A+
sources.evidence: Dated May 20, 2026; announces this exact identifier as released and explicitly places it in the Command A family. Confirms total/active counts, MoE, reasoning, tool use, context and license.

sources.title: North Small Translate: Advanced Cost-Effective Translation (Cohere CAT+)
sources.evidence: September 2026 first-party report: Table 1 has an exact Command A+ row with 218B total and 25B active. Section 2.1 identifies Command A+ as a decoder-only sparse MoE Transformer and links its dated BF16 checkpoint.

sources.title: Command A+ BF16 configuration
sources.evidence: Multimodal wrapper contains cohere2_moe text and SigLIP vision configurations, with 128 routed experts, eight selected per token, num_shared_experts=4 and max_position_embeddings=200000. The implementation expands one shared MLP by that factor; the documented supported context remains 128K.

sources.title: Cohere2 MoE shared-expert implementation
sources.evidence: Cohere2MoeSparseMoeBlock constructs one Cohere2MoeMLP for shared experts with intermediate_size multiplied by num_shared_experts. Thus config num_shared_experts=4 denotes the width of one combined shared MLP and is compatible with the model card describing one shared expert block.

developer.note: Cohere and its research lab developed the model.

family.note: The release note explicitly identifies the Command A family.

release_date.note: Dated launch announcement and release note agree.

open_weights.note: First-party checkpoint releases are available in multiple precisions.

license.note: Published license for the released weights.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported nominal total in billions; not an independently enumerated exact learned-tensor count or component-only figure. The later report confirms the exact model row.

active_parameters_b.note: Separately reported nominal active count in billions; not inferred from total or expert fraction. No modality/phase breakdown is established.

architecture.note: Sparse MoE Transformer language backbone with a vision encoder. The shared-expert implementation creates one shared MLP whose intermediate width is four times the routed-expert width, reconciling the card and configuration descriptions.

context_window.note: Published context limit; config position capacity 200000 does not supersede the documented supported limit.

reasoning.note: Reasoning mode and thinking-token examples are documented.

tool_call.note: Model card explicitly describes training and templates for conversational tool calls.

description.value: Cohere's open-weight sparse MoE model for multilingual agents, reasoning, and enterprise tasks, with text and image inputs.
description.note: Replace the vague comparative stronger claim with concrete documented capabilities.

patch.name: Command A+
patch.description: Cohere's open-weight sparse MoE model for multilingual agents, reasoning, and enterprise tasks, with text and image inputs.

sources.label: Later Cohere report, Table 1 and section 2.1

patch.notes: 218B total and 25B active are developer-reported nominal counts, not exact learned-tensor enumerations. The model combines a sparse MoE language backbone with vision support. Active counts are not broken down by modality or execution phase. The documented 128,000-token context is retained despite a larger configuration position capacity.

summary: All 14 fields reviewed against primary evidence. Added the disclosed nominal 218B total / 25B active counts, MoE architecture and Apache-2.0 license; normalized display name and description. Release date and existing capabilities are confirmed. Later Cohere research confirms the exact model counts. The implementation reconciles shared-expert descriptions by combining their width into one shared MLP; no exact learned-tensor count is claimed.
